articles.title: Crypto industry urges SEC to avoid blanket novel ETF restrictions
articles.snippet: Grayscale, a16z, and the CCI asked the SEC to preserve existing classification rules and avoid treating novel exchange-traded products as a single category, while proposing different routes to clearer and faster reviews.

articles.title: Crypto Groups Push SEC for Tailored Rules on Novel ETFs
articles.snippet: Groups including The Crypto Council for Innovation, Grayscale, and a16z urged the regulator to preserve existing fund classifications and streamline reviews for new exchange-traded products.
